eA.reading: the D-2 rule (a cut is non-consecutive exactly when its adjacent-across anchors are jointly co-parented by a layer window) holds for every census row whose windows are all cyclic intervals and none is full-range; non-cyclic windows span cuts without any adjacent-anchor witness (uncut spanning) and full-range windows witness every cut without breaking consecutiveness
eA.rule: spanning(k) is attributable to adjacent-anchor co-parenting iff N(k) (windows containing both adjacent anchors, size < n) is non-empty for every spanning cut; the reduction is exact for a census row iff no window is non-cyclic and none is full-range; the exact-witness / rotation equivalence is asserted for every cut of every row (rotationAgrees); the complete per-row fault loci live in the spanning map (nonCyclicWindows / fullRangeWindows)

eB.reading: direction 1 holds exactly when every window is a cyclic interval (then every shared set of size >= 2 is a cyclic run and contains an adjacent pair); direction 2 holds exactly when no spanning cut is single-witnessed; the A1 x A2 census (the D1 instance) satisfies both
eB.rule: direction 1: every reach co-parented pair (shared >= 2 parents) whose shared set contains a cyclically adjacent pair produces spanning at that cut (fertility); direction 2: every spanning cut is produced by a co-parented pair iff it is pair-witnessed (exact witnesses >= 2; any two witnesses of a cut share the adjacent anchor pair)

eC.reading: the containment relation (overlap >= 2) is exactly the Hamming-2 partner relation (all overlap-5 pairs are Hamming-2, verified); the reach relation binds states by shared cycle anchors; the two relations coincide only where a Hamming-2 partner pair also shares >= 2 cycle-anchor parents
eC.rule: heptatonic-side containment co-parenting (subnodes overlap >= 2) among the reached layer states vs the reach co-parenting pairs of the same census; coincidence = pairs satisfying both

eD.reading: no pentatonic cycles exist (G1), so the pentatonic-side correspondence binds through the pentatonic satellite layers on the heptatonic cycles; every such reach pair is a global containment-co-parented pair by construction (the shared cycle anchors are shared containment parents)
